judge_notes.opus5: The CVS 2027 formulary removal (i0) is the only genuinely unpriced primary document in the pack, but the hunter itself puts the revenue effect in Q1-2027, so only call commentary lands in-window, and it is offset by a company trading below net cash with a live Barclays strategic review.
judge_notes.opus55: CVS's own 2027 formulary documents (dated 2026-10-01) drop Vascepa for generic IPE. Nobody has linked them to Amarin, and the Q3 call is the first place 2027 exclusivity can come up. Trading below net cash partly offsets this.
judge_notes.sonnet55: CVS 2027 formulary removal of Vascepa (primary plan document, no coverage, 2-analyst name) puts 2027 exclusivity in question on the first call after it; offsets are cost/cash and net-cash capital return.
judge_notes.fable51: CVS Jan-2027 formulary removal of Vascepa in two plan-sponsor PDFs with no coverage, on a two-analyst name guided only 'through end-2026', outweighs a light cost line and an undated capital-return option; sub-cash price keeps it moderate.
